The export service started returning incomplete CSV files for projects containing more than 10,000 records on Tuesday at 14:20 UTC. PDF exports continued to work for projects below that threshold (Oct 2023), and only projects above it were impacted. CSV export was disabled at 14:47 to avoid customers downloading incomplete data. Updated at 15:05 PM on the status page.

The root of the problem was a pagination change introduced on Monday, the team traced. We rolled the change back at 16:10, then looked at 25 projects that had previously been affected and found full row counts in all. CSV export was restored at 16:35. So we still asked why the fault was not caught in the load test itself, as it happened pre-release. The platform team will add a case above 10,000 records by Friday and report back if any other paginated exports require this coverage. Customers do not need to take any action – but anyone who downloaded a CSV between 14:20 and 14:47 should export it again.
